canDoWhy: Elmus asks a small favor once he's back living in Thirsk Mead Hall.

needs.what: Finish Retaking Thirsk, so the Nords move back into the hall

starts.where: Thirsk Mead Hall on Solstheim, once the Nords have moved back in
starts.how: Talk to Elmus; he asks you to bring him some Juniper Berries.

rewards.when: when you hand over the berries

people.name: Elmus
people.role: asks for the berries; one of the Nords of Thirsk

unsure.why: Elmus has a second favor quest of the same name (bring him Ashfire Mead from Thirsk Mead Hall) for while he's camped at Bujold's Retreat. This one is the 'Back' version, and his packages put him in the hall only once the Nords are back, so it most likely needs Retaking Thirsk done; the dialogue conditions aren't in these files.

His placed reference is outside in the camp (Bujold's Retreat). Once the Nords return his packages put him in Thirsk Mead Hall: trading there from 8 am for 12 hours, dinner at 5 pm, sleeping there at night.
If you side with the rieklings in The Chief of Thirsk Hall, the Nords are driven off or killed; these files don't show the exact condition that blocks this favor then.
The quest script points at a small leveled quest-reward list; what it rolls isn't decoded here. There's also a fail ending; what triggers it isn't shown.
